svg.title: Stolarski–Su finite-time neck collapse
svg.desc: Schematic profiles · the exact flow is constructed by a nonlinear parabolic PDE

g.text: Schematic profiles · the exact flow is constructed by a nonlinear parabolic PDE
Neck scale is comparable to (T − t)ᴷ⁄²; curvature to (T − t)⁻ᴷ⁄².
n = 3: K = 2, 3, 4. n ≥ 4: every integer K ≥ 2. Ambient space: Cⁿ.
